literature.primary_two_body_source: Sun, Feng and Zhang, Communications Physics 9,146 (2026), published Eq.(6), doi:10.1038/s42005-026-02580-0
literature.role: The finite-momentum contact loop and continuum scattering framework are inherited. Uniform spectral estimates and their source-weighted deterministic-time consequences are the present additions.

new_proofs: Momentum-integrated contact-continuum variation is uniformly bounded for U in a fixed compact interval beginning at Uc, although fiber variation may grow as |P|^(z-1).
Exact derivative-envelope estimates give sharper L2 band norms; the norm thresholds are properties of the sufficient bound, not physical transitions.
A sufficient joint time-detuning regime recovers the unconditional fractional-cutoff coincidence probability at deterministic time.
next_task: Claims-first manuscript compression and focused stress review of the uniform spectral estimate, not automatic Hamiltonian expansion or optimization of every sufficient bound.
